findings.explanation: Special case. In HOL4 nothing fixes the namespace key types: the statement uses only nsAll2 (polymorphic in 'm,'n) with a lambda that ignores its identifier argument, and tenvV and envV carry no type annotation. Its principal type therefore has envV : ('a,'b,v) namespace and tenvV : ('a,'b,num#t) namespace. Lean fixes both to modN/varN (mlstring) through tenv_val and env_val, so it says nothing about, for example, num-keyed namespaces. Other lemmas in this module (weak_ctMap_lookup, weakS_refl, weakCT_refl) keep HOL4's polymorphism.
findings.repair:
theorem type_tenv_val_weakening_lemma {M N : Type} :
    ∀ (ctMap : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tenvV : Namespace M N (Nat × Ty)) (envV : Namespace M N Value)
      (ctMap' : _root_.ctMap) (tenvS' : tenv_store),
      weakCT ctMap' ctMap ∧
      weakS tenvS' tenvS ∧
      nsAll2 (fun _ v p =>
          ∀ (tvs' : Nat) (ctMap' : _root_.ctMap) (tenvS' : tenv_store),
            (p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = tvs') ∧
            weakCT ctMap' ctMap ∧
            weakS tenvS' tenvS →
            type_v tvs' ctMap' tenvS' v p.2)
        envV tenvV →
      nsAll2 (fun _ v p => type_v p.1 ctMap' tenvS' v p.2) envV tenvV := by
  sorry
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Weakening

example (M N : Type) (c : ctMap) (s : tenv_store) (tV : Namespace M N (Nat × Ty))
    (eV : Namespace M N Value) : True := by
  fail_if_success (have := type_tenv_val_weakening_lemma c s tV eV)
  trivial
findings.hol4_check: !ctMap tenvS (tenvV:('a,'b,num#t) namespace) (envV:('a,'b,v) namespace) ctMap' tenvS'. weakCT ctMap' ctMap /\ weakS tenvS' tenvS /\ nsAll2 (\i v (tvs,t). !tvs' ctMap' tenvS'. (tvs = 0 \/ tvs = tvs') /\ weakCT ctMap' ctMap /\ weakS tenvS' tenvS ==> type_v tvs' ctMap' tenvS' v t) envV tenvV ==> nsAll2 (\i v (tvs,t). type_v tvs ctMap' tenvS' v t) envV tenvV
